name: betteragent-highlighter
description: Applies editor decorations requested by the BetterAgent VSCode presenter MCP server (services/mcp_vscode) so the agent can highlight code while narrating a walkthrough.

betteragent-highlighter.signalPath.description: Path to the highlight signal file written by services/mcp_vscode/server.py (must match that server's --signal-path). Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder.
